{{Quote|Good work! Here, take this. Not sure why I saved a painting of that horrible place, can't stand to look at it anyway.|Pfilbee Jhorn|<ref name="SWGquest">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=faction|Imperial|Pfilbee Jhorn: Kill some Dune Lizards|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
A '''painting''' depicting the landscape of the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] was available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="SWGpaint" /> sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Note">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Opening Crawl}} places the events of the [[Star Wars video games|game]] after the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], which occurred during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War's]] [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> [[Pfilbee Jhorn]], custodian of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine's]] [[Imperial garrison (Bestine)|Imperial garrison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], owned a copy of the [[Painting/Legends|painting]], despite perceiving Endor as a horrible place and being unable to appreciate the art.<ref name="SWGquest" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|faction=[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial faction]]}}
Jhorn gave a copy of the painting to an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-aligned [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] after they [[Death/Legends|eradicated]] pests around the city for him, such as [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rats]]<ref>{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=faction|Imperial|Pfilbee Jhorn: Kill some Womp Rats|Tatooine}}</ref> and [[Dune lizard/Legends|dune lizards]].<ref name="SWGquest" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The painting of Endor's landscape appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']].<ref name="SWGpaint" /> It was the final reward from a small chain of quests given by Pfilbee Jhorn at Bestine's Imperial garrison<ref name="SWGquest" /> and could be used in the player's house as a decoration. Although the work was titled simply ''Painting'' in the game, its description stated that it depicts the landscape of the forest moon of Endor.<ref name="SWGpaint" /> ''Galaxies'' shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
